notes: Read SKILL.md and references/details.md in full. The skill explains configuring and running ShellCheck: installation, .shellcheckrc, common SC codes, strict/relaxed/CI invocations, pre-commit hook, GitHub Actions and GitLab CI jobs, suppression directives, parallel/cached runs and output formats.

Medium: the installation section (references/details.md:16-30) would have the agent install ShellCheck with brew or apt-get, or clone github.com/koalaman/shellcheck and run `make install`. Acceptable because these are the tool's standard install routes from official sources and only happen when the user wants ShellCheck set up; everything else is running a read-only linter, writing .shellcheckrc/hook/CI files, and creating a local .shellcheck_cache directory (references/details.md:359-360).

Accuracy caveats, not safety issues: some 'fixes' repeat the problem code (references/details.md:103, 115, 284), and SHELLCHECK_SHELL/SHELLCHECK_STRICT/SHELLCHECK_CONFIG (references/details.md:56-62) are not documented ShellCheck variables (ShellCheck reads SHELLCHECK_OPTS). The GitHub Actions example pins actions/checkout@v3 by tag only.
